content.short: Build and deploy dApps on a single platform with Demeter effortlessly scale to support millions of users.
content.description: Demeter is a cloud infrastructure platform from TxPipe for building and deploying Cardano applications. It gives developers managed access to middleware and services such as Ogmios, Kupo, and other Cardano backend components without requiring teams to operate their own nodes or indexers. Demeter handles monitoring, security, version upgrades, and regional provisioning so projects can focus on application logic. Its role is to make Cardano infrastructure easier to launch, scale, maintain, and monitor.
content.meta: Demeter provides managed Cardano infrastructure and middleware for dapp developers and teams. Explore Demeter on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
